definitions.name: R2A.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'R2A.RX' BIND 'R2A.RA' BIND R2A.RA -1 GET 'R2A.RL' BIND R2A.RA -1 DROP R2A.RL 0 GET R2A.RL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT R2A.RA R2A.RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.RL 0 GET R2A.RX EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: RLE fold step: Vector of [ value count ] pairs and a value -> pairs with the last count bumped or a new [ value 1 ] appended

definitions.name: R2A.RLE
definitions.body: 'R2A.RV' BIND R2A.RV R2A.RV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ R2A.RLESTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs in order

definitions.name: R2A.UPSTEP
definitions.body: 'R2A.UX' BIND 'R2A.UA' BIND R2A.UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 R2A.UX R2A.UA 0 GET GT SELECT 'R2A.UC' BIND R2A.UX R2A.UC R2A.UA 2 GET R2A.UC MAX 3 COLLECT
definitions.note: fold step for increasing runs: [ prev current best ] and a value -> next [ prev current best ]

definitions.name: R2A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'R2A.DN' BIND 1 R2A.DN RANGE 'R2A.DR' BIND R2A.DN R2A.DR DIV 'R2A.DQ' BIND R2A.DR 0 R2A.DQ FLOOR R2A.DQ LT NOT SELECT [ 0 GT ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> Vector of its positive divisors, ascending

definitions.name: R2A.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'R2A.CI' BIND 'R2A.CA' BIND R2A.CA 0 GET 'R2A.CV' BIND R2A.CV 2 DIV 'R2A.CH' BIND R2A.CV 1 EQ 'R2A.CD' BIND 1 R2A.CH R2A.CV 3 MUL 1 ADD R2A.CH FLOOR R2A.CH EQ SELECT R2A.CD SELECT R2A.CA 1 GET 0 1 R2A.CD SELECT ADD 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: Collatz fold step: [ value steps ] and an ignored element -> next [ value steps ], standing still once value is 1

definitions.name: R2A.BVAL
definitions.note: bracket char -> 1 for an opener, -1 for a closer

definitions.name: R2A.FFSTEP
definitions.body: 'R2A.FX' BIND 'R2A.FA' BIND R2A.FA R2A.FX 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.FX NIL? SELECT GET
definitions.note: forward-fill step: last value and current reading -> the reading, or the last value when the reading is NIL

definitions.name: R2A.GSTEP
definitions.note: gap-length step: current run length and a 0/1 gap flag -> run length + 1 on a gap, 0 otherwise

definitions.name: R2A.RTSTEP
definitions.body: 'R2A.TX' BIND 0 GET 'R2A.TP' BIND R2A.TX NIL 1 R2A.TX 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.TX NIL? SELECT GET 1 R2A.TP 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.TP NIL? SELECT GET DIV 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.TX NIL? NOT R2A.TP NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT GET 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: ratio scan step: [ prev ratio ] and a reading -> [ reading reading/prev ], the ratio NIL when either is NIL

definitions.name: R2A.SCALE1
definitions.body: 'R2A.SM1' BIND 'R2A.SX' BIND NIL 1 R2A.SX 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.SX NIL? SELECT GET R2A.SM1 DIV 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.SX NIL? SELECT GET
definitions.note: reading (maybe NIL) and a divisor -> reading / divisor, NIL stays NIL

definitions.name: R2A.OPRICE
definitions.body: 'R2A.OO' BIND R2A.OO 'price' GET 'R2A.OP' BIND 0 R2A.OP 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.OP NIL? SELECT GET
definitions.note: order Record -> its price, or 0 when it has none

definitions.name: R2A.LINE
definitions.body: 'R2A.OL' BIND R2A.OL R2A.OPRICE R2A.OL 'qty' GET MUL
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price (0 when unpriced)

definitions.name: R2A.REVENUE
definitions.note: orders Vector -> exact total of qty times price over priced orders

definitions.name: R2A.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: 'R2A.QO' BIND R2A.QO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP R2A.QO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'R2A.QG' BIND R2A.QG KEYS R2A.QG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD

definitions.name: R2A.OTAGS
definitions.body: 'tags' GET 'R2A.OT' BIND [ ] R2A.OT 2 COLLECT 0 1 R2A.OT NIL? SELECT GET UNIQUE
definitions.note: order Record -> its distinct tags, or an empty Vector when it has none

definitions.name: R2A.WORDS
definitions.note: space-separated String -> Vector of its non-empty words

definitions.name: R2A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS -1 DROP JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of Strings -> them joined by single spaces
